entities.name: Maria Doménech
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Domènech i Escoté was a novelist, poet and social activist from the Catalonia region of Spain. While living in Tarragona, she wrote using the pseudonym Josep Miralles. She was later known by her married name, Maria Domènech de Cañellas.
